query: Consider ADVANIDE's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: The obligations accruing prior to termination as set forth herein, shall, however, survive the termination of this Agreement for a period of two years.
rag_answer: Yes. Clause 7 of the ADVANIDE Non-Disclosure Agreement states that obligations accruing prior to termination shall survive the termination of the Agreement for a period of two years.
